candidates.description: Chip stock selloff stole the spotlight this week. The chip stock selloff dominated the week, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling for an eighth straight session, its longest streak since 2008, and the Nasdaq sliding 4.5%. Yet TSMC posted a record profit up nearly 69% and ASML booked record sales, so the businesses kept growing while the share prices fell. Hot US inflation, Brent near $110 on Hormuz risks and a silent Fed added to the pressure, while Singapore's index held at 5,415.5
candidates.headline: GoodWhale Weekly: Chip Stock Selloff Hits 8 Days, Oil Nears $110, Singapore Exports Surge 68%

candidates.description: STI bank selloff stole the spotlight this week. The STI bank selloff dominated the week in Singapore, with the index sliding about 4.1% to 5,401.89 as OCBC, UOB and DBS tumbled on Wednesday and Thursday. The trigger was global: the US 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.364%, a 24-year high, while Fed minutes showed most officials still expect one more hike. AI chips fell after an OpenAI revenue scare, Brent climbed to $104.72, and SpaceX's spectrum purchase knocked about 9% off the US telecom giants.
candidates.headline: GoodWhale Weekly: STI Bank Selloff Wipes 4.1%, Yields Hit a 24-Year High, AI Chips Wobble
